concerns.text: The task IDs and sequence in `plan.md` (T001, T005, T016, T029, etc.) completely diverge from the actual task list in `tasks.md` (T001-T012). The plan describes a different set of work units than the execution list, breaking the traceability between the implied plan and the tasks.

Inconsistent use of `[P]` tags. T007 is marked `[P]` (parallel-safe), but T005 and T006—which are also pure consumers of the T004 model artifact and produce distinct outputs—are not. This is a consistency nit but affects the clarity of the parallelization strategy.
